Title: Python support in Azure Functions is now available

Body.Content:
Python support in Azure Functions is now generally available and ready for production workloads. Build your serverless functions using Python 3.6 with the high productivity programming model enabled by the open-source and cross-platform Functions 2.0 runtime. Python functions can target Linux-based hosting options in Azure including both Consumption and Premium hosting plans. Serverless Python workloads are supported by the world-class development experience of Azure Functions including VS Code integration and CI/CD through Azure Pipelines.

Learn more in the Azure blog
